caption:
Three calls to the same number isn't follow-up.

It's one closed door, knocked on three times.

Switch the channel every time a touch goes unanswered. The lead who ignored your call might answer a text an hour later.

The ladder:
Minute 0: call.
No answer at minute 2: text.
No reply by the hour mark: email with the next step.
Still quiet by day two: a different number or a short video text.

Each channel earns a different kind of attention. The lead who never checks voicemail still reads a text at a red light.

Want this built into your follow-up?
DM SCALE

#LeadFollowUp #SpeedToLead #ServiceBusiness #SmallBusinessGrowth #CRMForContractors
rationale: Carousels still lead saves and depth for B2B authority content, and this channel-switch mental model is unclaimed, distinct from every prior stage, ladder, cadence, decay, and capacity framework already shipped.
